name: Task Shader Cell Classification
aliases: Task Shader: Cell Classification and Task Generation
definition: A task shader workgroup processes one volume block to identify occupied cells, create a compact list of those cells, and emit mesh shader workgroups. This minimizes mesh shader invocations by acting only on occupied cells.
summary: Task Shader Cell Classification is a GPU-driven pipeline stage that filters sparse volume data by identifying occupied cells and compacting their indices to minimize mesh shader invocations.
